TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.title: Target Controls
TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.description: TcHmiEcSlave controls which show the slave selected in the topology.

propertiesMeta.name: control
propertiesMeta.description: TcHmiEcSlave control which shows the slave selected in the topology.

TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.title: Zoom Mode
TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.description: Reference of the zoom levels. 'Absolute' renders a terminal with 400px x 100px at 100 %. 'ScaleToFit' shows the complete topology at 100 %.

TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.title: Pan Bounds
TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.description: Controls how far the topology can be panned. 'Free' allows moving it out of view. 'KeepContentInFrame' keeps the topology inside the visible frame.

TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.title: Preview Visibility
TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.description: Controls when the topology preview is shown. 'OnlyWhenZoomedIn' shows it when the topology is zoomed beyond its fitted view.

TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.title: TopologyView
TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.description: Position and zoom of the topology view.

propertiesMeta.name: posX
propertiesMeta.description: Horizontal translation of the topology view in pixels.

propertiesMeta.name: posY
propertiesMeta.description: Vertical translation of the topology view in pixels.

propertiesMeta.name: zoom
propertiesMeta.description: Zoom of the topology view in percent, relative to the reference of the zoom mode.

TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.title: InitTopologyView
TcHmi.Controls.Beckhoff.TcHmiEcDiagnosti.description: Definition of cell options in the grid.

propertiesMeta.name: posX
propertiesMeta.description: Default is zero. Set a number to adjust the initial horizontal translation of the topology view in pixels.

propertiesMeta.name: posY
propertiesMeta.description: Default is zero. Set a number to adjust the initial vertical translation of the topology view in pixels.

propertiesMeta.name: zoom
propertiesMeta.description: Default is the calculated zoom factor so that the topology covers the available space. Set a number to adjust the initial zoom of the topology view. Zoom 100 renders a terminal with 400px x 100px.
